title: Does this look good in your opinion ?
author: Ok-Shock4663
selftext: I just gave my steam page to review and I have been wondering does this look good or like clickable atleast I am not sure my previous game i messed up a lot so kinda need your opinion.

comments.author: Human-Tr
comments.body:
How can I know?  
We need more context

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: The context it's a horror game as you can see in the environment and it's a story about a guy who went to meet his brother whom he was separated in a orphanage and the protagonist grew up in a war background

replies.author: Human-Tr
replies.body:
Haha, thank you.  
To be honest your description is more appealing than the screenshot

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: Yeah I have written description as well but like it is not shown here kinda I can share 8 to 9 images here I am still waiting for steam to approve the page

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Ok-Shock4663 please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: Ok but this wasn't made with ai like I did take help for ai like once I guess for a bit of puzzle mechanic nothing else so should I share this as non ai game ?or ai game ?

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: Yeah I know but i wanna share all but steam hasn't  approved my page and it will take time as their backlog is stacked right now there are many but what can I do 🙂

replies.author: zmizzy
replies.body: well until you decide to actually talk about your game I'm going to assume you put as much effort into development as you do the discussion. so it's probably a very sloppy low quality game

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: I don't think it's right to judge a game by its devloper and another you could have just asked for context of the game as well like even a bit i would have told you . 😅

replies.author: zmizzy
replies.body: of course its right. it shows a real lack of planning and thought. even now you fail to update the main post with these important details. all i can say is best of luck to you boss

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: I guess you are right then , I lack planning and thought about my players, but could I have made a game without it i  doubt about it my page would have been really bad I think . It's not like I am genuis at marketing I don't expect to be one. I just came to reddit excited to share my game even a bit because I was happy 😁. And I have seen people love to read images rather than descriptions that's why I never wrote one that big and I don't wanted to say to you but I think there is a short description on the right side of steam page where you could have viewed the game about but instead you choose to just make fun of me by saying that I don't talk about the game . It seems a bit ridiculous to me I guess 🤔

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: The context it's a horror game as you can see in the environment and it's a story about a guy who went to meet his brother whom he was separated in a orphanage and the protagonist grew up in a war background but after he gets dismissed he tries to meet his brother back again and reached this house but he has heard some crazy rumours about the house along the way .

comments.author: glimsky
comments.body: The screenshot looks interesting, but I don't like the capsule - looks amateurish, but maybe it is still a work in progress. I also don't like the game's name, feels generic.

replies.author: Ok-Shock4663
replies.body: Yeah it's my first time creating a proper capsule art by myself and I think I am bit happy with it but still work upon it to make it better

replies.author: glimsky
replies.body: Keep it up - the capsule is super important and I'm sure you can do better.
